services.title: Collection
services.subtitle: Professional collection services for efficiently collecting your unpaid invoices. Transparent, fast and reliable.

easySubmission.title: Easy assignment submission
easySubmission.description: Submit your collection assignment easily through our online portal. Upload the required documents and provide all relevant information. Your assignment is registered within minutes.

autoCheck.title: Automatic verification
autoCheck.description: Our advanced system automatically checks all submitted information for completeness and accuracy. We verify the debtor's data and check the validity of the claim.

professionalContact.title: Professional contact
professionalContact.description: We immediately contact the debtor through various channels. Our experienced staff work on a quick and friendly solution for your claim.

noCureNoPay.title: No cure - no pay
noCureNoPay.description: You only pay when the collection is successful. No result, no costs. Our transparent pricing structure means you always know where you stand.

fastTreatment.title: Fast processing
fastTreatment.description: Within 24 hours of submitting your assignment, the first steps are taken. No waiting times, no delays - immediate results.

allAmounts.title: For all amounts
allAmounts.description: Whether it's small or large amounts, we help you collect your unpaid invoices. No minimum or maximum amount.

debtorManagement.title: Debtor management
debtorManagement.subtitle: Fully automatic invoice management
debtorManagement.description: At Auxilium, we ensure that all purchase invoices in your system are automatically maintained and followed up. We monitor your outstanding invoices and ensure timely payment, so you don't have to worry.
debtorManagement.autoFollowup: Automatic follow-up of all purchase invoices
debtorManagement.noWorries: No more worries about missed payments

howItWorks.title: Our approach
howItWorks.subtitle: A transparent and professional process for collecting your unpaid invoices

sensitivityScan.title: Sensitivity scan
sensitivityScan.description: After receiving each file, we first scan its sensitivity. Are they regular customers with good relationships? Has the invoice recently expired? Based on these factors, our system can determine whether we start with a reminder without additional costs or not.

firstContact.title: First contact
firstContact.description: After our system has determined the sensitivity, we contact the customer for the first time. This is done in a friendly and professional manner, tailored to the relationship and situation.

intensiveFollowup.title: Intensive follow-up
intensiveFollowup.description: Still no payment after 3-5 business days? Then we proceed to more intensive follow-up: we send a reminder, a registered shipment and make a personal call. We remain professional but make it clear that payment is expected.

ultimatum.title: Ultimatum and legal steps
ultimatum.description: Still no payment? Then we proceed to an ultimatum where we make it clear that the next steps will be legal. We give a final chance, but also make it clear that we will not hesitate to take legal action if necessary.

pricing.title: Our prices
pricing.subtitle: Transparent and fair prices - only pay on success
pricing.ratesDescription: We work with a progressive rate. The higher the invoice amount, the lower the percentage. This makes our service advantageous for both small and large amounts.

noCureNoPay.title: No cure - no pay
noCureNoPay.description: At Auxilium, you only pay when the collection is successful. No result, no costs. This means you take no risk - we share the risk with you.
noCureNoPay.noAdvance: No advance payments or monthly costs
noCureNoPay.progressive: Progressive rate - more advantageous for higher amounts

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Our story, our values and our mission

founding.title: The start of Auxilium
founding.description: Auxilium Incasso is founded with the vision to help companies efficiently collect unpaid invoices. With years of experience in the financial sector, the foundation is laid for a reliable collection agency.

trusted.title: Consultant and trusted advisor
trusted.description: As a consultant and trusted advisor, a solid reputation is built. Customers appreciate the personal approach and expertise in collection and debtor management.

anniversary.title: Years of growth and success
anniversary.description: Over the years, Auxilium grows into a reliable partner for many companies. The anniversary marks years of successful collections and satisfied customers.

takeover.title: A new chapter
takeover.description: After the passing, the children take over the company. With respect for the built values and expertise, the legacy is continued and the company is brought into the future.

modern.title: Modern approach with financial expertise
modern.description: With a strong financial background, a new step is taken. Modern technology and advanced systems are integrated, while maintaining the personal approach and reliability.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions

questions.question: How does no cure no pay work?
questions.answer: With no cure no pay, you only pay when the collection is successful. If the debtor does not pay, you pay nothing.

questions.question: How quickly is an assignment processed?
questions.answer: Assignments are processed within 24 hours. The debtor immediately receives a payment request by email.

questions.question: What are the costs?
questions.answer: The costs consist of a percentage of the collected amount or a fixed amount, depending on the amount of the claim. Contact us for a detailed quote.

questions.question: Can I track the status of my assignments?
questions.answer: Yes, through the customer portal you always have insight into the status of your collection files.

faq.moreQuestions: Do you have any questions? Contact us.
